1# heap sort
2def heap_sort(lst):
3    # create empty array
4    sorted_array = []
5    # create heap
6    heap = MinHeap()
7    # insert heap
8    for i in lst:
9        heap.insert(i)
10    # extract min
11    for i in range(len(lst)):
12        sorted_array.append(heap.extract_min()) 
13    # return sorted array
14    return sorted_array

items: If you want to sort the list in descending order, you can simply reverse the sorted list using return array[::-1].
If you use a max heap instead of a min heap, the normal sort would give the list in descending order, whereas the reversed sort (using [::-1]) would give the list in ascending order.
